### Summary

I am running into the following behavior of `uv`: 

1. The workspace root has a CodeArtifact index with `aws` username embedded into the URL: `https://aws@<repo>-<account>.d.codeartifact.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/pypi/`
2. I am running `uv add <package> --index <index>` in a workspace member. This works, and also `uv` re-adds the same index without the `aws@` username to the workspace member's `pyproject.toml`: `https://<repo>-<account>.d.codeartifact.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/pypi/<package>/simple/`. This is the first bug, a new `indices` entry should not have been created in the first place.  
3.`uv lock` now fails with:

```
Resolving despite existing lockfile due to change in pre-release mode: `allow` vs. `if-necessary`
  × Failed to resolve dependencies for `<a>` (v0.1.0)
  ╰─▶ Requirements contain conflicting indexes for package `<b>` in split `python_full_version >= '3.13.12' and
      python_full_version < '3.14' and sys_platform == 'win32'`:
      - https://****@<repo>-<account>.d.codeartifact.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/pypi/<package>/simple/
      - https://<repo>-<account>.d.codeartifact.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/pypi/<package>/simple/
```

this is the second bug. 

Probably, both bugs are caused by the same issue: `uv` doesn't recognize these index URLs as equal just because one of them has `aws@` username embedded. I guess they should be deduplicated instead (e.g. tried sequentially until the first credential variant works given they point at the same repo anyway). 



### Platform

Darwin 25.5.0 arm64 Darwin

### Version

uv 0.12.5 (210d1f678 2026-08-14 aarch64-apple-darwin)

### Python version

Python 3.13.12
title: Index URLs with different credentials but the same registry endpoint are not deduplicated
